pages.https://emberwiki.example/wiki/Fort_Joy:
Fort Joy

Fort Joy is the island prison where Emberfall begins: you wake on the beach below the keep.

Getting out

The only way off the island is by boat from the Saltmarsh Docks, south of the keep.
pages.https://emberwiki.example/wiki/Saltmarsh:
Saltmarsh Docks

The harbour south of Fort Joy. The harbourmaster, Edda Vane, sells the boat ticket to the mainland for 120 gold, only after nightfall.
